description: This file defines a custom exception class `InvalidParentGLAccountHeadException` used within the GL account module of the accounting component. It extends a platform-specific exception class and encapsulates an error condition related to mismatched account parent IDs.

classes.name: InvalidParentGLAccountHeadException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that the parent GL account ID does not match the expected ID, preventing invalid account hierarchy configurations.

methods.name: InvalidParentGLAccountHeadException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with specific GL account ID and parent ID, setting an appropriate error message.
